# Aaron Clayton

> UX-minded systems engineer. I make complex systems people actually use, then take the
> manual work out of them.

Aaron Clayton works at the intersection of user experience, systems management, automation
and applied AI. He designs the parts of a system people touch, builds the infrastructure
underneath it, and automates processes once they are understood and stable. Based in Niagara,
Canada.

## Focus areas

- **User experience** — designing systems people don't fight; the interface is where a system
  succeeds or fails.
- **Systems management** — infrastructure that stays up, stays observable and stays cheap.
- **Automation and applied AI** — removing manual work, and applying AI only where it earns
  its place.

## Selected work

- [Automated bug investigation](/work/bug-investigation/): investigations run one per bug in
  parallel through Herdr against a single shared read-only worktree, and the resolution plan
  becomes a GitHub tracking issue — with every mutating step decided by deterministic script
  logic, never by an agent's claim of success.
- [End-to-end personal finance automation](/work/finance-automation/): four source formats into
  one store, then six ordered matching tiers governed by one invariant — a receipt is evidence,
  never a financial event. 2,214 records.
- [Voice-to-knowledge pipeline](/work/voice-knowledge/): phone dictation filed as a structured,
  linked note — and the design before it, which could never have worked, and why.
